lead.question: 拉姆齐太太说猫很 dear，为什么作者说它 dear 得“不止一层含义”？
lead.warmup: 一只作息极有规律的猫突然失踪，三天后一封匿名信索要赎金——故事就这样轻松诙谐地展开。作者用冷静克制的口吻叙述一桩“绑架案”，结尾却靠 dear 一词的双关点出幽默：猫对主人是心爱之物，对钱包却是昂贵之物。阅读时请留意事件如何层层推进，以及间接引语、条件句和分词短语怎样把信中的威胁转述得不动声色。
goals: 掌握 kidnap、ransom、anonymous、withdraw、punctually、astounded 等本课核心词汇。
理解 dear 的双关：既指“心爱的”，又指“昂贵的”。
学会用间接引语转述他人的陈述（stated、was instructed、explained）。
体会条件句与分词短语在叙事中的表达作用。
lead.summary: 拉姆齐太太是位富有的老妇人，多年来与爱猫拉斯同住。拉斯生活规律，傍晚散步后总在七点前回家。可一天晚上它没回来，三天后她收到匿名信：付 1,000 美元赎金便把猫归还，并把钱放进纸盒留在门外。她原想报警，却怕再也见不到猫，只得从银行取钱照办。次日盒子不见，当晚七点拉斯准时归来，只是渴得喝了半瓶牛奶。警察听后大为震惊，她说拉斯很 dear；念及那笔钱，这 dear 便有了双重含义。
lead.tips: dear 在本课是双关：既表“亲爱的、心爱的”，又表“昂贵的”。切勿一律译成“亲爱的”，须结合语境判断含义。

questions.q: Why was Rastus 'very dear' in more ways than one?
questions.zh: 为什么拉斯“贵重”得不止一层含义？
questions.a: Because Rastus was dear to Mrs. Ramsay (he was her beloved cat), and he was also dear in the sense of expensive, since she had paid a ransom of $1,000 to get him back.
questions.aZh: 因为拉斯对拉姆齐太太来说是心爱之物（她珍爱的猫），同时它也是“昂贵”的——她为赎回它付了 1,000 美元赎金。
questions.hint: 答案见课文最后两句：'She explained that Rastus was very dear to her. Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!'

questions.q: What kind of life did Rastus lead?
questions.zh: 拉斯平时过着怎样的生活？
questions.a: He led an orderly life. He usually took a short walk in the evenings and was always home by seven o'clock.
questions.aZh: 它生活很有规律，傍晚常常出去溜达一会儿，总在七点钟以前回家。
questions.hint: 见课文第三、四句（'Rastus leads an orderly life...'）。

questions.q: What did the anonymous letter ask Mrs. Ramsay to do?
questions.zh: 那封匿名信要求拉姆齐太太做什么？
questions.a: It stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned if she paid a ransom of $1,000; she was instructed to put the money in a cardboard box and leave it outside her door.
questions.aZh: 信中说拉斯安然无恙，只要她付 1,000 美元赎金便立即归还；并要求她把钱放进纸盒，留在门外。
questions.hint: 见匿名信内容两句（'The writer stated...' / 'Mrs. Ramsay was instructed...'）。

questions.q: What condition was Rastus in when he returned?
questions.a: He looked very well, though he was rather thirsty, for he drank half a bottle of milk.
questions.aZh: 它看上去很好，只是渴得厉害，喝了半瓶牛奶。
questions.hint: 见课文倒数第三句（'He looked very well though he was rather thirsty...'）。

questions.q: Why did Mrs. Ramsay decide not to go to the police in the end?
questions.zh: 拉姆齐太太为什么最后决定不去报警？
questions.a: Because she feared that she would never see Rastus again -- the letter had made that quite clear -- so she changed her mind and paid the money.
questions.aZh: 因为她怕再也见不到拉斯——信上把这点说得十分明白——于是改变了主意，付了钱。
questions.hint: 见她改变主意的那句（'At first she decided to go to the police, but fearing that...'）。

exercises.q: 汉译英：绑架者很少对动物感兴趣，但最近他们对拉姆齐太太的猫产生了极大的兴趣。
exercises.a: Kidnappers are rarely interested in animals, but they recently took considerable interest in Mrs. Ramsay's cat.

exercises.q: 语法填空：Mrs. Ramsay received an ____ letter demanding a ____ of $1,000.
句型转换：将直接引语改为间接引语。He said, 'Rastus is in safe hands and will be returned immediately if you pay a ransom.'
exercises.a: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if she paid a ransom.

exercises.q: 改错：She withdrawed $1000 from her bank and followed the kidnapper's instructions.
exercises.a: withdrawed → withdrew（withdraw 的过去式不规则）。

exercises.q: 汉译英：她怕再也见不到拉斯，于是改变了主意。
exercises.a: Fearing that she would never see Rastus again, she changed her mind.

exercises.q: 填空并解释：Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one! 句中 dear 的两个含义分别是？
exercises.a: “心爱的”和“昂贵的”；considering 意为“考虑到”。
exercises.note: dear 双关：心爱的／昂贵的。

exercises.q: 条件句填空：The cat ____ (return) immediately if Mrs. Ramsay ____ (pay) a ransom of $1,000.
exercises.a: would be returned / paid（与将来事实相反的假设用过去式）。
exercises.note: 条件句主句用 would+动词原形。

quiz.q: 课文标题 A very dear cat 中，dear 的含义是？
options: beloved and expensive
only expensive
only beloved
cheap and worthless

quiz.q: 拉斯的日常作息是怎样的？
options: He never goes out of the flat.
He spends the whole night outside.
He takes a short walk in the evenings and is home by seven.
He comes home at midnight every day.

quiz.q: 那封匿名信提出了什么要求？
options: Hand the cat over to the police.
Move to another city at once.
Give the writer some jewellery instead.
Pay a ransom of $1,000 and leave the money in a cardboard box outside the door.

quiz.q: 拉姆齐太太最初想报警，为什么又改变主意？
options: The police refused to help her.
She feared she would never see Rastus again.
She had no money to pay the ransom.
The cat had already come back by then.

quiz.q: 拉斯回到家中时状态如何？
options: He looked very well though he was rather thirsty.
He was badly injured and weak.
He was very hungry and thin.
He was fast asleep and could not move.
quiz.note: drank half a bottle of milk。

quiz.q: 警察听到拉姆齐太太的做法后反应如何？
options: They laughed at her.
They praised her for her cleverness.
They were astounded.
They were quite indifferent.
